title: Memory Channel
text: Stream data through a memory channel, 6 inputs, 8 outputs, {Sample time} sets Time interval of sampling; {Hardware board} sets the view or modify current hardware settings Read-only: name of selected hardware, {Show implementation info} sets the view channel information Read-only: text, {Enable memory simulation} controls memory simulation accuracy, {Channel type} sets the channel protocol, {Region size (bytes)} sets the size of memory allocated for region, in bytes Read-only, {Buffer size (bytes)} sets the size of buffer, in bytes, {Number of buffers}, {Burst length}, {Use hardware board settings} uses the Hardware Implementation settings from the configuration, {Reader/Writer use same values} sets the reader and writer use the same values, {FIFO depth (number of bursts)} sets the depth of FIFO for data, {Almost full depth} sets the depth of FIFO when backpressure, {Clock frequency (MHz)} sets the interconnect frequency of master datapath, {Data width (bits)} sets the data width of master datapath, {Dimensions}, {Data type}, {Enable sample packing (last signal dimension as channel)} sets the pack data on the last dimension, {Output data signal matches input} sets the reader and writer use the same values, {Inherit sample time offset} sets the make reader inherit sample time, {Use pixel clock sample times} uses the pixel clock sample time, {Frame size} sets the frame dimensions 480p SDTV and {Launch performance plots} displays performance metrics. Values come from the instance.
